name: The Archive Office
description: A small apartment that has slowly become something else. Shelves. Cables. Hard drives. A corkboard with photos and string. The terminal is the oldest thing here.

interactables.label: Camera Bag
interactables.text: A worn camera bag. The strap has been replaced twice. Inside: two lenses, a battery pack, and a memory card labeled 'DO NOT FORMAT.'

interactables.label: Notebook
interactables.text: Pages of handwritten notes. Names, dates, locations. Most have arrows connecting them. A few lines are underlined three times.
